description: Temmy Shmull, Governor of Peleliu, signs the papers that permit the improvement of the road infrastructure on Peleliu, Republic of Palau, Aug. 1, 2021. With this signed document it allows the task force to facilitate the improvement of local roads through Surangel & Sons Co., a provider of goods and services in the Republic of Palau, and in turn provide a safer path for travel for the community and provides all students with a safer bus ride to the school.
